black-forest-labs.name: Black Forest Labs

entry.amount: undisclosed (total raised 'over $450M' including the USD 300M Series B and the USD 31M seed)
entry.quote: a previously unannounced Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from BroadLight Capital, Creandum, Earlybird VC, General Catalyst, Northzone, and Nvidia
entry.entry_asserted: The company's seed announcement (2024-08-01) names a16z, five angels and follow-up money from General Catalyst and MätchVC, not Earlybird. The company's Series B release names Earlybird VC first in the previously unannounced Series A. The firm's own 2025 review: 'since backing Freiburg-based Black Forest Labs (BFL) in 2024, we announced our follow-on support, culminating in combined Series A & B rounds of $450M+' (https://earlybird.com/perspectives/long-on-europe-reviewing-2025-at-earlybird). So the first round is the Series A, closed in 2024; the Series B of Dec 2025 is the follow-on. The list's 'Series B' label is wrong.

black-forest-labs.status_detail: Operating; USD 300M Series B announced 1 Dec 2025 with Earlybird VC among the participants. No later round found (Google News: 'Black Forest Labs valuation raises 2026 Series C'; German: '"Black Forest Labs" Bewertung Finanzierungsrunde 2026').

valuation.basis: Priced round: 'a $300M Series B led by AMP and Salesforce Ventures, at a post-money valuation of $3.25B' (company release, 2025-12-01). Same figure as the a16z, Bain Capital Ventures, Cherry and Creandum books.

black-forest-labs.notes: Frontier image-generation lab (FLUX models), Freiburg. Earlybird first invested in the a16z-led Series A, closed in 2024 and announced only with the Series B in Dec 2025, where it followed on. Latest priced valuation USD 3.25B post-money (Dec 2025). Same reading as the Creandum book (Series A entry).
